antithesis: Prolonged exposure at 670nm may decrease mitochondrial biogenesis and generate oxidative stress in microglia if irradiance exceeds optimal threshold. Paper (2024) notes dose-dependent tissue response.
synthesis: Apply Multi-wavelength cascade: 447 THz (670nm) prep + 370 THz (810nm) main + 306 THz (980nm) recovery targeting cytochrome_c in microglia. Study reference: 2024 peer-reviewed paper shows electron transport +12% at 670nm. Dual-phase protocol minimizes off-target thermal effects while maximizing mitochondrial citrate_synthase activation.
